/community/config.about: C3 is a friendly, multigenerational church at our Downtown Toronto campus near Dovercourt Park. We gather on Sunday mornings across three services, share a free Community Meal every Tuesday and look after each other through Connect Groups, C3 Kids, Youth, tutoring and volunteer Teams. Everyone is welcome, whatever they believe or wherever they are on the journey.

events.description: An evening for the women of C3: worship, a short talk and time to connect over dessert. Bring a friend, no RSVP required at the door but it helps us plan food.
events.prep: Come as you are. Childcare is not provided for this evening.

events.title: Volunteer Day: Food Bank & Garden
events.description: Join a Team: pack hampers for the neighbourhood food bank, then weed and plant in our church garden. Gloves and lunch provided. Tasks for all ages and abilities.
events.prep: Wear closed shoes and clothes that can get dirty.

resources.title: Meal Train: cook for a family in need
resources.description: When a family welcomes a baby, has surgery or hits a hard patch, we organise a meal rota. Sign up to bring one dinner: we handle the schedule and dietary notes.
resources.author: Ruth Abernathy
resources.how_to_claim: Add your name to the current rota. Ruth will send the address and preferences.

resources.title: Learn the sound desk: AV team training
resources.description: A relaxed 90-minute session on the mixer, cameras and livestream. No experience needed. Join the rota when you're ready.
resources.author: Samir Haddad
resources.how_to_claim: Reply to Samir with a date that suits you.

resources.title: Homework Club: tutors needed
resources.description: Tuesday and Saturday sessions for students in grades 3 to 10. No teaching experience needed, just patience. Training and a police check are provided by the church.
resources.author: Naomi Bekele
resources.how_to_claim: Message Naomi with your preferred day. New tutors shadow for one session.

resources.title: Free budgeting and tax clinic
resources.description: One-on-one sessions with a chartered accountant for anyone who wants help with a budget, tax return or benefits form. Confidential and free to everyone in the neighbourhood.
resources.author: Helen Park
resources.how_to_claim: Book through Helen. Bring last year's return if you have it.

resources.title: Ride Share: Sunday drivers list
resources.description: Members who drive can offer seats to neighbours who can't get to the gathering. Add yourself as a driver, or ask for a ride.
resources.author: James Whitaker
resources.how_to_claim: Message James with your area and how many seats you have.

resources.title: Newcomer's guide to Dovercourt Park
resources.description: A friendly two-page guide to schools, libraries, clinics, community centres, the best cheap lunches and how to get around the west end without a car.
resources.author: Priscilla Tan
resources.how_to_claim: Open the guide or pick up a printed copy at the welcome table.

/announcements.title: Fall welcome: new neighbours' lunch
/announcements.body: After the Sunday Gathering on the 3rd we'll host a lunch for anyone new to the church or the neighbourhood. Pastor Jonathan and the welcome team will be there, and it's a great way to meet people.
/announcements.author: Pastor Jonathan Martin

/announcements.title: Volunteers needed: Community Meal kitchen
/announcements.body: Ruth's team needs two more cooks and two dishwashers for the Tuesday Community Meal. Training is friendly, and you'll be fed.
/announcements.author: Ruth Abernathy

/announcements.title: Youth Night is back on Thursdays
/announcements.body: Youth Night moves back to Thursdays from 6 pm. Grades 6 to 12, pizza and games. Two more adult volunteers are welcome.
/announcements.author: David Okafor

/announcements.title: Vision Builders: thank you
/announcements.body: Thank you for helping us reach 82% of our goal toward this year's Vision Builders campaign for our Downtown campus. Join us at the Vision Builders Gala on October 30th to hear what's next.
/announcements.author: Helen Park

/events/evt-grace-8.title: Community Meal: Harvest Supper
/events/evt-grace-8.description: A larger meal for the whole neighbourhood, with soup, bread and pies from seven of our kitchens.
agenda: Pie auction for the food bank

/events/evt-grace-7.title: Sunday Gathering: Last Week
/events/evt-grace-7.description: Last Sunday's gathering, with a guest speaker on hospitality and a welcome lunch for new neighbours. Notes and photos are in the news tab.

/events/evt-grace-9.title: HER Night
/events/evt-grace-9.description: An evening for the women of C3: worship, a short talk and time to connect over dessert. Bring a friend, no RSVP required at the door but it helps us plan food.
/events/evt-grace-9.prep: Come as you are. Childcare is not provided for this evening.

/events/evt-grace-1.title: Sunday Gathering
/events/evt-grace-1.description: Our weekly morning together: music from C3 Worship, a short talk from Pastor Jonathan, and coffee in the hall after. We run three services (8:30, 10:00 and 11:45 am); this is the 10:00. Children are welcome, with C3 Kids running downstairs for the whole service.
/events/evt-grace-1.prep: Come as you are. Newcomers can find the welcome table by the front door.

/events/evt-grace-2.title: Community Meal: Neighbours' Table
/events/evt-grace-2.description: A free hot meal for anyone in the neighbourhood, cooked by our kitchen team. Come hungry, bring a friend, stay for dessert and conversation.
/events/evt-grace-2.prep: Let us know about allergies when you RSVP. Vegetarian and gluten-free options every week.

/events/evt-grace-3.title: Connect Group: Kitchen Table Conversations
/events/evt-grace-3.description: An informal evening Connect Group that meets in a home near Bloorcourt. Supper, a short reading and honest conversation about faith, work and life.
/events/evt-grace-3.prep: Bring a dessert or a drink if you like. Address is sent after you RSVP.

/events/evt-grace-4.title: Volunteer Day: Food Bank & Garden
/events/evt-grace-4.description: Join a Team: pack hampers for the neighbourhood food bank, then weed and plant in our church garden. Gloves and lunch provided. Tasks for all ages and abilities.
/events/evt-grace-4.prep: Wear closed shoes and clothes that can get dirty.

related_resources.title: Homework Club: tutors needed

/events/evt-grace-5.title: Youth Night: Games & Pizza
/events/evt-grace-5.description: Our weekly night for teens in grades 6 to 12: games, pizza, a short discussion and a chance to unwind after school. Adult volunteers welcome.
/events/evt-grace-5.prep: Teens can bring a friend. Parents are welcome to stay for coffee.

related_resources.title: Homework Club: tutors needed

/events/evt-grace-6.title: Prayer Evening
/events/evt-grace-6.description: A quiet, unhurried hour of reflection and prayer with candles and soft music, hosted with our Pastoral Care team. Come for as long as you like, and take a moment for yourself, your neighbours or the city.
/events/evt-grace-6.prep: No experience needed. Silence is welcome.

/events/evt-grace-10.title: Vision Builders Gala
/events/evt-grace-10.description: A celebration evening for our Vision Builders stewardship initiative: dinner, stories from the past year and a look at what's next for our Downtown campus. Semi-formal.
/events/evt-grace-10.prep: Tickets support the Vision Builders fund. Semi-formal attire.

/community/config.about: The Village is a members-only supper club in Toronto. Once or twice a month, fourteen guests sit down at one long table for a chef-led dinner with wine pairings. Between dinners, members meet at wine Salons, market mornings and counter evenings with guest chefs. Membership is by invitation and application.

/support-requests.title: Seeking a plus-one for the Autumn Harvest dinner

/support-requests.title: Venue for a private 30th-anniversary dinner

/support-requests.title: Non-alcoholic pairing ideas for the Loft dinners

/support-requests.description: Trying to source a few cases of Savagnin and Poulsard for the Salon. If any of you know a small importer with a spare allocation, an introduction would help.

/support-requests.title: Introductions to florists who love foraged material
/support-requests.description: Looking for a florist for table arrangements with seasonal, foraged material: branches, herbs, berries. Low and unfussy.

/support-requests.title: Chefs willing to be interviewed for my book
/support-requests.description: I'm writing about supper clubs and would love thirty minutes with anyone who runs one, or cooks at one. Coffee on me.

/support-requests.title: A reliable game supplier
/support-requests.description: I need pheasant, quail and a little venison from a small Ontario farm. Ideally someone who delivers to downtown twice a week.

/support-requests.title: A north-facing studio for a chef portrait series
/support-requests.description: I'm shooting portraits of local chefs in their own kitchens and need a couple of extra locations with good light. Suggestions welcome.

/resources.how_to_claim: Open the guide.

/support-requests.title: Seeking a plus-one for the Autumn Harvest dinner
/support-requests.description: My usual guest is travelling. I'd love to bring someone curious who enjoys good conversation and doesn't mind a slow pace. Happy to cover the seat.

/support-requests.title: Venue for a private 30th-anniversary dinner
/support-requests.description: Thirty guests, a Saturday in November, somewhere with atmosphere and a real kitchen. Ideas welcome, including private dining rooms not on the usual lists.

/support-requests.title: Non-alcoholic pairing ideas for the Loft dinners
/support-requests.description: I'd like to build a proper zero-proof pairing for the dinners. Would anyone like to taste through a few options before the next dinner?

/support-requests.description: Trying to source a few cases of Savagnin and Poulsard for the Salon. If any of you know a small importer with a spare allocation, an introduction would help.

/support-requests.title: Introductions to florists who love foraged material
/support-requests.description: Looking for a florist for table arrangements with seasonal, foraged material: branches, herbs, berries. Low and unfussy.

/support-requests.title: Chefs willing to be interviewed for my book
/support-requests.description: I'm writing about supper clubs and would love thirty minutes with anyone who runs one, or cooks at one. Coffee on me.

/support-requests.title: A reliable game supplier
/support-requests.description: I need pheasant, quail and a little venison from a small Ontario farm. Ideally someone who delivers to downtown twice a week.

/support-requests.title: A north-facing studio for a chef portrait series
/support-requests.description: I'm shooting portraits of local chefs in their own kitchens and need a couple of extra locations with good light. Suggestions welcome.

/resources.how_to_claim: Automatic for members. You'll get an invitation email when a date is released.

/resources.title: 15% off at Bell & Barrel Wine Merchants
/resources.description: Members receive 15% off any case and complimentary delivery downtown. Ask for the members' cellar list.
/resources.author: Marguerite Bell
/resources.how_to_claim: Quote 'The Village' when ordering, or send Marguerite a note.

/resources.title: Complimentary aperitif at Petit Foyer
/resources.description: A glass of house aperitif with your first course on any weeknight, and a kitchen tour if you ask nicely.
/resources.author: Julien Moreau
/resources.how_to_claim: Book online and mention The Village in the notes.

/resources.title: Agora Meze House: members' table for six
/resources.description: Reserve the long table at the back of the room, with a chef's selection of dishes for the middle of the table. Members only.
/resources.author: Theo Papadakis
/resources.how_to_claim: Email the restaurant with your date and party size.

/resources.title: How we pair wine with a five-course menu
/resources.description: Ines's working notes on structuring a pairing: acidity, weight, sequencing and when to break the rules. Includes a template we use for every dinner.
/resources.author: Ines Okoye
/resources.how_to_claim: Open the guide.

/resources.title: Atelier 9 private dining room: members' rate
/resources.description: Our long-table home is a light-filled loft on Queen West. Members can book it for private dinners and celebrations at a reduced weekday rate.
/resources.author: Victor Lam
/resources.how_to_claim: Message Victor or Camille with your date and party size.

/support-requests.title: Seeking a plus-one for the Autumn Harvest dinner
/support-requests.description: My usual guest is travelling. I'd love to bring someone curious who enjoys good conversation and doesn't mind a slow pace. Happy to cover the seat.

/support-requests.title: Venue for a private 30th-anniversary dinner
/support-requests.description: Thirty guests, a Saturday in November, somewhere with atmosphere and a real kitchen. Ideas welcome, including private dining rooms not on the usual lists.

/support-requests.title: Non-alcoholic pairing ideas for the Loft dinners
/support-requests.description: I'd like to build a proper zero-proof pairing for the dinners. Would anyone like to taste through a few options before the next dinner?

/support-requests.title: Looking for Jura allocations
/support-requests.description: Trying to source a few cases of Savagnin and Poulsard for the Salon. If any of you know a small importer with a spare allocation, an introduction would help.

/support-requests.title: Introductions to florists who love foraged material
/support-requests.description: Looking for a florist for table arrangements with seasonal, foraged material: branches, herbs, berries. Low and unfussy.

/support-requests.title: Chefs willing to be interviewed for my book
/support-requests.description: I'm writing about supper clubs and would love thirty minutes with anyone who runs one, or cooks at one. Coffee on me.

/support-requests.title: A reliable game supplier
/support-requests.description: I need pheasant, quail and a little venison from a small Ontario farm. Ideally someone who delivers to downtown twice a week.

/support-requests.title: A north-facing studio for a chef portrait series
/support-requests.description: I'm shooting portraits of local chefs in their own kitchens and need a couple of extra locations with good light. Suggestions welcome.

/matches.profile_hint: Complete your profile to improve recommendations.

/announcements.title: Autumn dates released
/announcements.body: The Ember & Ash long-table dinner and the Autumn Harvest dinner are now open to members. Seats go quickly, so reserve within the 48-hour window.
/announcements.author: Camille Laurent

/announcements.title: Guest chef announced: Theo Papadakis
/announcements.body: Theo Papadakis of Agora Meze House will cook an eight-seat Chef's Counter next week. Only eight places, and three are taken.
/announcements.author: Camille Laurent

/announcements.title: New: Members' offers
/announcements.body: Bell & Barrel, Petit Foyer and Agora Meze House are now our founding partners. Discounts, complimentary pours and a members' table are all listed in Members' offers.
/announcements.author: Camille Laurent

/announcements.title: House etiquette, refreshed
/announcements.body: A short reminder of how we host: phones in the coat room, no talk of work at the table, arrive on time and bring curiosity. Read the note before your next dinner.
/announcements.author: Camille Laurent

/events/evt-the-village-8.title: Wine Salon: Orange & Amber
/events/evt-the-village-8.description: An evening exploring skin-contact wines from Georgia, Friuli and Prince Edward County with Ines Okoye.

related_resources.title: 15% off at Bell & Barrel Wine Merchants

/events/evt-the-village-7.title: Long Table Dinner: Late Summer
/events/evt-the-village-7.description: Last month's dinner: heirloom tomatoes, grilled sardines and a peach galette. Photographs by Rosa are in the news tab.
/events/evt-the-village-7.location: The Loft at Atelier 9 · Queen West

/events/evt-the-village-1.title: Long Table Dinner: Ember & Ash
/events/evt-the-village-1.description: Fourteen guests, one table, five courses cooked over live fire by Julien Moreau, with a wine pairing curated by Ines Okoye. Menu revealed at the table.
/events/evt-the-village-1.location: The Loft at Atelier 9 · Queen West
/events/evt-the-village-1.prep: Arrive on time. Tell us about allergies when you reserve your seat.

related_resources.title: How we pair wine with a five-course menu

/events/evt-the-village-2.title: Chef's Counter: Theo Papadakis
/events/evt-the-village-2.description: An eight-seat counter with guest chef Theo Papadakis: a Cretan tasting menu cooked in front of you, with a glass of something Greek and unfiltered.

/events/evt-the-village-3.title: Wine Salon: Burgundy vs. Niagara
/events/evt-the-village-3.description: A blind flight of twelve pinots and chardonnays from Côte d'Or and Niagara with Ines Okoye and Marguerite Bell. Bring a palate and an open mind. Members only.
/events/evt-the-village-3.prep: Arrive without strong perfume. We provide water and crackers.

related_resources.title: 15% off at Bell & Barrel Wine Merchants

/events/evt-the-village-4.title: Market Morning: St. Lawrence
/events/evt-the-village-4.description: A slow, guided walk through the Saturday market with Julien and Sasha, followed by breakfast made from what we buy. Bring a tote bag.
/events/evt-the-village-4.location: St. Lawrence Market · meet at the clock
/events/evt-the-village-4.prep: Comfortable shoes and a tote bag.

/events/evt-the-village-5.title: Members' Supper
/events/evt-the-village-5.description: An informal supper only for members: a family-style menu from the regulars, natural wine on the table and no formalities. Bring a bottle you'd love to share.

/events/evt-the-village-6.title: Long Table Dinner: Autumn Harvest
/events/evt-the-village-6.description: Our seasonal long-table dinner: squash, game, late-season tomatoes and a very serious apple tart. Fourteen guests, one table.
/events/evt-the-village-6.location: The Loft at Atelier 9 · Queen West

/community/config.about: Club PTO is a padel club in Toronto with three courts, a weekly ladder league, and coaching for every level from total beginners to tournament players. We run clinics, socials, junior camps and a livestreamed ladder final each season. Members get priority court booking, equipment perks and a genuinely friendly bunch of regulars.

/events.title: Tuesday Ladder Night
/events.description: Our weekly ladder league night: score-tracked doubles across four divisions, on all three courts. Come rain or shine, we're covered.
/events.prep: Check your division and opponent on the ladder board before you arrive.

/events.title: Beginner Clinic: First Steps on Court
/events.description: A relaxed 90-minute intro for total beginners: grip, the glass walls, scoring and your first rally. Loaner racquets provided, no experience needed.
/events.prep: Wear court shoes if you have them; loaners available otherwise.

/events.title: Junior Padel Camp
/events.description: Saturday morning coaching for kids 8 to 15: footwork games, wall drills and mini-matches, run by our juniors coach Hassan and volunteers.
/events.prep: Parents welcome to watch from the lounge.

/events.title: Footwork & Fitness Clinic
/events.description: Natasha's monthly clinic on court movement, split-step timing and recovery: less about hitting, more about getting there first.
/events.prep: Bring indoor court shoes and a water bottle.

/events.title: Round Robin Social
/events.description: A friendly mixed round robin with rotating partners, followed by pizza on the patio. All levels welcome, especially newer players.
/events.prep: New players are paired with a regular for their first match.

/events.title: Stringing & Equipment Pop-Up
/events.description: Elena sets up her stringing bench courtside for the evening: same-day restrings, grip advice and a look at the new racquet demo line.
/events.prep: Book a restring slot at the front desk; walk-ins fit in when possible.

/events.title: Ladder Finals Night
/events.description: The Tuesday ladder's top two in each division play off for the season trophy, livestreamed by Jordan to the club Instagram.
/events.prep: Come cheer even if you're not in the finals; there's a full bar cart.

/events.title: Fall Mixer & Sponsor Night
/events.description: An evening celebrating our fall tournament sponsors, with exhibition doubles from the coaches and a raffle for club merch.
/events.prep: Business casual. Sponsors and their guests are welcome.

/resources.title: 10% off restrings at Vasquez Racquet Studio
/resources.description: Members get 10% off any restring and free grip installation at Elena's studio in the Junction, or at her courtside pop-ups.
/resources.author: Elena Vasquez
/resources.how_to_claim: Mention Club PTO at the studio or the pop-up.

/resources.title: Ladder league: how divisions work
/resources.description: Marcus's guide to the Tuesday ladder: promotion and relegation, how byes are handled, and how to challenge for a higher spot.
/resources.author: Marcus Webb
/resources.how_to_claim: Open the guide.

/resources.title: Junior clinic: loaner racquets for kids
/resources.description: We keep a bin of kid-sized racquets for the Saturday junior clinic. Borrow one for the season while your child decides if padel sticks.
/resources.author: Hassan Ali
/resources.how_to_claim: Ask Hassan on a Saturday morning.

/resources.title: Footwork & recovery: a starter routine
/resources.description: Natasha's simple five-minute warm-up and cool-down routine for padel, built to protect knees and ankles on hard courts.
/resources.author: Natasha Kim
/resources.how_to_claim: Open the guide.

/resources.title: Booking app help & livestream archive

/resources.author: Jordan Lee
/resources.how_to_claim: Message Jordan with a screenshot of what's not working.

/resources.title: Bright Court Sports: 15% off club merch
/resources.description: Our fall tournament sponsor offers Club PTO members 15% off padel shoes, bags and apparel, in-store or online.
/resources.author: Winston Park
/resources.how_to_claim: Show your member card in-store, or use the code at checkout online.

/support-requests.title: Ride-share from Roncesvalles for Tuesday ladder
/support-requests.description: I drive in most Tuesdays and have two spare seats. Happy to pick up along Roncesvalles or Bloor West if anyone wants to skip the streetcar with a racquet bag.

/support-requests.title: Two more volunteers for the junior clinic
/support-requests.description: Saturday mornings, 9 to 11. No coaching experience needed, just patience with 8-to-15-year-olds and a decent forehand.

/support-requests.title: Practice partner for Wednesday footwork drills
/support-requests.description: Looking for a regular Wednesday evening partner to run footwork and wall drills with, roughly intermediate level.

/support-requests.title: Photographer for the fall mixer
/support-requests.description: Looking for anyone handy with a camera to shoot the fall mixer and sponsor night. Happy to comp your guest ticket.

/support-requests.title: Co-commentator for the ladder finals livestream
/support-requests.description: Streaming the finals solo gets long. Looking for someone who knows the ladder standings to jump on mic for commentary.

/support-requests.title: Beginner partner for Sunday mornings
/support-requests.description: New to padel and looking for another beginner to hit with before the Sunday round robin gets going. No pressure, just rallying.

/support-requests.title: Spare padel shoes, size 8-9 women's
/support-requests.description: Restringing a pair someone left months ago and never claimed. If they're yours, or you just need a spare pair that size, come find me at the front desk.

/support-requests.title: Local businesses for the fall tournament prize table
/support-requests.description: Chasing a few more prize donations for the fall tournament: gear, gift cards, anything padel-adjacent. Introductions welcome.

/support-requests.title: Co-commentator for the ladder finals livestream

/support-requests.title: Beginner partner for Sunday mornings
/support-requests.description: New to padel and looking for another beginner to hit with before the Sunday round robin gets going. No pressure, just rallying.

/support-requests.title: Spare padel shoes, size 8-9 women's

/support-requests.title: Local businesses for the fall tournament prize table
/support-requests.description: Chasing a few more prize donations for the fall tournament: gear, gift cards, anything padel-adjacent. Introductions welcome.

/events/evt-club-pto-1.title: Tuesday Ladder Night
/events/evt-club-pto-1.description: Our weekly ladder league night: score-tracked doubles across four divisions, on all three courts. Come rain or shine, we're covered.

related_resources.title: Ladder league: how divisions work

/events/evt-club-pto-2.title: Beginner Clinic: First Steps on Court
/events/evt-club-pto-2.description: A relaxed 90-minute intro for total beginners: grip, the glass walls, scoring and your first rally. Loaner racquets provided, no experience needed.
/events/evt-club-pto-2.prep: Wear court shoes if you have them; loaners available otherwise.

/events/evt-club-pto-3.title: Junior Padel Camp
/events/evt-club-pto-3.description: Saturday morning coaching for kids 8 to 15: footwork games, wall drills and mini-matches, run by our juniors coach Hassan and volunteers.

related_resources.title: Junior clinic: loaner racquets for kids

/events/evt-club-pto-4.title: Footwork & Fitness Clinic
/events/evt-club-pto-4.description: Natasha's monthly clinic on court movement, split-step timing and recovery: less about hitting, more about getting there first.
/events/evt-club-pto-4.prep: Bring indoor court shoes and a water bottle.

related_resources.title: Footwork & recovery: a starter routine

/events/evt-club-pto-5.title: Round Robin Social
/events/evt-club-pto-5.description: A friendly mixed round robin with rotating partners, followed by pizza on the patio. All levels welcome, especially newer players.
/events/evt-club-pto-5.prep: New players are paired with a regular for their first match.

/events/evt-club-pto-6.title: Stringing & Equipment Pop-Up
/events/evt-club-pto-6.description: Elena sets up her stringing bench courtside for the evening: same-day restrings, grip advice and a look at the new racquet demo line.
/events/evt-club-pto-6.prep: Book a restring slot at the front desk; walk-ins fit in when possible.

/events/evt-grace-9.prep: Come as you are. Childcare is not provided for this evening.

/events/evt-grace-1.title: Sunday Gathering
/events/evt-grace-1.description: Our weekly morning together: music from C3 Worship, a short talk from Pastor Jonathan, and coffee in the hall after. We run three services (8:30, 10:00 and 11:45 am); this is the 10:00. Children are welcome, with C3 Kids running downstairs for the whole service.
/events/evt-grace-1.prep: Come as you are. Newcomers can find the welcome table by the front door.

/events/evt-grace-2.title: Community Meal: Neighbours' Table
/events/evt-grace-2.description: A free hot meal for anyone in the neighbourhood, cooked by our kitchen team. Come hungry, bring a friend, stay for dessert and conversation.
/events/evt-grace-2.prep: Let us know about allergies when you RSVP. Vegetarian and gluten-free options every week.

/events/evt-grace-3.title: Connect Group: Kitchen Table Conversations
/events/evt-grace-3.description: An informal evening Connect Group that meets in a home near Bloorcourt. Supper, a short reading and honest conversation about faith, work and life.
/events/evt-grace-3.prep: Bring a dessert or a drink if you like. Address is sent after you RSVP.

/events/evt-grace-4.title: Volunteer Day: Food Bank & Garden
/events/evt-grace-4.description: Join a Team: pack hampers for the neighbourhood food bank, then weed and plant in our church garden. Gloves and lunch provided. Tasks for all ages and abilities.
/events/evt-grace-4.prep: Wear closed shoes and clothes that can get dirty.

/events/evt-grace-5.title: Youth Night: Games & Pizza
/events/evt-grace-5.description: Our weekly night for teens in grades 6 to 12: games, pizza, a short discussion and a chance to unwind after school. Adult volunteers welcome.
/events/evt-grace-5.prep: Teens can bring a friend. Parents are welcome to stay for coffee.

/events/evt-grace-6.title: Prayer Evening
/events/evt-grace-6.description: A quiet, unhurried hour of reflection and prayer with candles and soft music, hosted with our Pastoral Care team. Come for as long as you like, and take a moment for yourself, your neighbours or the city.
/events/evt-grace-6.prep: No experience needed. Silence is welcome.

/events/evt-grace-10.title: Vision Builders Gala
/events/evt-grace-10.description: A celebration evening for our Vision Builders stewardship initiative: dinner, stories from the past year and a look at what's next for our Downtown campus. Semi-formal.
/events/evt-grace-10.prep: Tickets support the Vision Builders fund. Semi-formal attire.

/users/u-founder-me.name: Fife Ashley-Dejo
/users/u-founder-me.title: Physiotherapist
/users/u-founder-me.bio: Physiotherapist who joined C3 two years ago and found a second family. I help on the welcome team, love a good potluck, and am always happy to chat posture, injuries and where to find a great coffee in Leslieville.

/users/u-g-admin.name: Pastor Jonathan Martin
/users/u-g-admin.title: Campus Pastor
/users/u-g-admin.bio: Campus Pastor at C3 Toronto's Downtown location, alongside his wife Angela. Preaches most Sundays and leads our Pastoral Care team. My door is open, so grab me after any gathering for a coffee.

/users/u-admin-me.name: Fife Ashley-Dejo
/users/u-admin-me.title: Community Lead
/users/u-admin-me.bio: I coordinate volunteer Teams and events between C3 and the wider Dovercourt Park community. Message me if you'd like to serve but aren't sure where to start.

/users/u-g-priscilla.name: Priscilla Tan
/users/u-g-priscilla.title: Music teacher
/users/u-g-priscilla.bio: I lead C3 Worship on Sundays and teach piano through the week. The choir is open to everyone, whether or not you think you can sing.

/users/u-g-david.name: David Okafor
/users/u-g-david.title: High school teacher
/users/u-g-david.bio: Teacher by day, youth leader on Thursday nights. Our teens are funny, thoughtful and full of ideas, and we'd love more adults who can simply show up and listen.

/users/u-g-ruth.name: Ruth Abernathy
/users/u-g-ruth.title: Retired nurse
/users/u-g-ruth.bio: Retired nurse and the person to ask about the Community Meal. I've been here since before the new roof. Bring your appetite and I'll find you a job.

/users/u-g-samir.name: Samir Haddad
/users/u-g-samir.title: Software developer
/users/u-g-samir.bio: I run the sound desk and the livestream for people who can't make it in person. Happy to teach anyone who's curious about cables and mixers.

/users/u-g-lucia.name: Lucia Fernandes
/users/u-g-lucia.title: Baker & mum of three
/users/u-g-lucia.bio: Three kids, one oven, and a heart for young families. Ask me about the Sunday kids' program or my pastel de nata.

/users/u-g-james.name: James Whitaker
/users/u-g-james.title: Carpenter & contractor
/users/u-g-james.bio: I lead Volunteer Day on the second Saturday of the month. If something needs fixing at church or at a neighbour's house, we'll bring the tools.

/users/u-g-naomi.name: Naomi Bekele
/users/u-g-naomi.title: Graduate student, education
/users/u-g-naomi.bio: I tutor on Tuesdays and Saturdays and I'm always looking for more students and more volunteers. No teaching experience needed, only patience.

/users/u-g-helen.name: Helen Park
/users/u-g-helen.title: Accountant
/users/u-g-helen.bio: Church treasurer and a numbers person. If money feels stressful, come and see me. I run a free budgeting clinic and there is no judgement here.

/users/u-g-elijah.name: Elijah Brooks
/users/u-g-elijah.title: Graphic designer
/users/u-g-elijah.bio: New dad, designer, and slowly-improving sleeper. I make the posters you see on our noticeboard and would love to help our outreach look great.

requests.name: Renata Silva
requests.title: Yoga Teacher
requests.bio: I teach yoga nearby and keep hearing about Unity's strength floor from my own students. Would love to cross-train.

requests.join_reason: Just moved to Harbourfront and looking for a gym with a real community, not just a place to lift alone.

/events/evt-unity-1.title: Sunrise HIIT Studio
/events/evt-unity-1.description: A 45-minute HIIT and Pilates-fusion class to start the day right. All levels — modifications shown for every move.

/events/evt-unity-2.title: Strength Foundations: Barbell Basics
/events/evt-unity-2.description: Squat, bench and deadlift technique from the ground up. Bring your own lifting shoes if you have them.

/events/evt-unity-3.title: Core & Conditioning Circuit
/events/evt-unity-3.description: A 40-minute conditioning circuit — kettlebells, sleds and core work in stations.

/events/evt-unity-4.title: Train United: Small Group Coaching
/events/evt-unity-4.description: Six-person coached sessions, programmed around your own goals. New cohort starts this week — spots are limited.

/events/evt-unity-5.title: Recovery & Mobility Workshop
/events/evt-unity-5.description: A slower session with Sofia on mobility work, stretching and recovery tools. Great after a heavy training week.

/events/evt-unity-6.title: Open Gym: Saturday Strength Hours
/events/evt-unity-6.description: Extended open-floor hours — no class, just the strength floor, the studio and the Members Lounge open all morning.

/events/evt-unity-7.title: 30-Day Movement Challenge Kickoff
/events/evt-unity-7.description: Sign up in person and get your challenge tracker. Prizes for consistency, not just intensity — everyone can place.

/events/evt-unity-8.title: UNITY360 Member Mixer
/events/evt-unity-8.description: Quarterly UNITY360 celebration — drinks, snacks and a chance to actually meet the people you train next to.

/events/evt-unity-9.title: Sweat Saturday: Pop-Up with lululemon
/events/evt-unity-9.description: A joint session with our friends at lululemon — outdoor circuit, gear try-ons and coffee after.

hub.about: A health and wellness brand that hosts networking nights, workshops and socials, and connects members who can help each other.

hub.name: C3
hub.tagline: Encounter Jesus and find home. Downtown Toronto.
hub.about: C3 is a friendly, multigenerational church at our Downtown Toronto campus near Dovercourt Park. We gather on Sunday mornings across three services, share a free Community Meal every Tuesday and look after each other through Connect Groups, C3 Kids, Youth, tutoring and volunteer Teams. Everyone is welcome, whatever they believe or wherever they are on the journey.

apply_questions.label: How did you hear about us?
apply_questions.placeholder: A neighbour, a poster, the Community Meal...

apply_questions.label: Is there something you're hoping to find here?
apply_questions.placeholder: Friends, a Connect Group, a way to serve...

hub.name: The Village
hub.tagline: Invite-only long-table dinners in Toronto. Fourteen guests, one table.
hub.about: The Village is a members-only supper club in Toronto. Once or twice a month, fourteen guests sit down at one long table for a chef-led dinner with wine pairings. Between dinners, members meet at wine Salons, market mornings and counter evenings with guest chefs. Membership is by invitation and application.

apply_questions.label: Who referred you?
apply_questions.placeholder: A member's name, or how you came across us

apply_questions.label: What do you love to eat?
apply_questions.placeholder: A dish, a region, a memorable meal...

hub.name: Club PTO
hub.tagline: A padel club for players of every level. Toronto.
hub.about: Club PTO is a padel club in Toronto with three courts, a weekly ladder league, and coaching for every level from total beginners to tournament players. We run clinics, socials, junior camps and a livestreamed ladder final each season. Members get priority court booking, equipment perks and a genuinely friendly bunch of regulars.

apply_questions.label: How did you hear about us?
apply_questions.placeholder: A friend, a walk-by, a search...

hub.name: Unity Fitness
hub.tagline: Building Community Through Movement — boutique fitness at Harbourfront, Toronto.
hub.about: Unity Fitness is a boutique fitness studio at Harbourfront in Toronto — strength training, varied studio classes, a members lounge and Train United coaching, all built around training together rather than training alone. Whatever your starting point, you're here to move, connect and exceed your own goals.

apply_questions.label: What brings you to Unity Fitness?
apply_questions.placeholder: Strength training, a class you love, coaching...

apply_questions.label: How did you hear about us?
apply_questions.placeholder: Instagram, a friend, walking by the studio...
